name: encode_accessibility_contrast
description: LOO prevalence-background-corrected accessibility contrast sets (Up/Down) from per-biosample accessible-gene collections

inputs.name: accessible_genes_dir
inputs.description: Directory of per-biosample accessible-gene set subdirectories (output of encode_accessible_genes or catlas_accessible_genes). Each subdir must contain geneset.tsv (one gene per line, header 'gene') and optionally geneset.meta.json with 'biosample' and group fields.

inputs.name: accessible_genes_zip
inputs.description: Zip archive of per-biosample accessible-gene set subdirectories. Alternative to accessible_genes_dir for compatibility with submission zips.

inputs.name: symbol_universe_tsv
inputs.description: Optional TSV whose first column is valid HGNC gene symbols (e.g. the GTEx t-stat matrix). Genes not in this universe are filtered out before contrast computation. Useful when input sets contain ENSG IDs or enhancer element IDs.

parameters.name: assay
parameters.help: Assay label for set names and provenance. Default 'ATAC-seq'.

parameters.name: low_prevalence
parameters.help: LOO-prevalence ceiling for Up (specifically accessible) sets. A gene is Up if it is accessible in this biosample AND its prevalence across all other biosamples is below this threshold. Default 0.25.

parameters.name: high_prevalence
parameters.help: LOO-prevalence floor for Down (specifically inaccessible) sets. A gene is Down if it is absent in this biosample AND its prevalence across all other biosamples is above this threshold. Default 0.75.

parameters.name: group_by_key
parameters.help: Optional metadata key from geneset.meta.json to use for within-group background computation. Example: 'library' for histone-mark sets (prevents pooling H3K4me3 with H3K27me3). If not set all biosamples are pooled into one background group.

parameters.name: lib_filter
parameters.help: Optional substring filter on the 'library' metadata field. Only sets whose library contains this substring are processed. Useful when processing a mixed-assay zip.

outputs.name: ENCODE_<assay>_<biosample>_accessible_Up/geneset.tsv
outputs.description: Gene list for the Up set

outputs.name: ENCODE_<assay>_<biosample>_inaccessible_Down/geneset.tsv
outputs.description: Gene list for the Down set
